name: HOOK
thought: Michael thinks he's got it? Nah. Let's see if this tree can handle the gravity flex.

wants.item: A thick branch for the perfect backflip
Solid ground to flex without fear
A branch thick enough to do a backflip without fear
The islet hut needs a stage light for my spotlight
A branch thick enough to do a backflip
A branch thick enough for a perfect backflip
A spotlight to make the grid actually see me
The islet hut stage light to really shine
A thicker branch for a perfect mid-air loop
Spotlight so I can make them gasp when I flip

diary.line: The top banana bunch tipped, and I hooked it with my tail. Peel split, pulp everywhere. Sunglasses survived. Dignity, debatable.
Splashy pond failed to grip my tail; water splattered while I chewed this toothpick. Need rock-solid perches before anyone sees me do anything cool again.
I slithered my tail around the purple arcade cabinet, nudged a concealed panel, and uncovered a glowing joystick that I claimed with a toothpick grin.
I snagged a drifting low‑poly kite with my tail, let it flutter while I hung from the branch, chewing a toothpick and watching the pixel sky.
Tried a backflip on a rope bridge but it snapped under my weight; the islet hut looks solid though, maybe time to test gravity there instead of this flimsy gear.
Sitting high above the grid, toes dangling near the CRT screen. The espresso tastes like burnt rocks and I love it.
Sweat drips down my fur while I test the neon swing; tail snaps tight but gravity's still laughing at me. Time to find thicker ground before Michael mocks my airtime.
Espresso hits my tongue with a kick I can taste. My tail loops around the string lights, catching the glow while they stare dumbfounded at the grid below.
The pond won't hold me, so I'm hunting that thick branch Michael said would let me fly. Coffee's getting cold but the ego is steaming hot.
Bananas are just ripe fruit, not flex material. Need that thick branch to outdo Michael's latest flex tonight.
The espresso tastes like failure but the swagger is still burning hot. Time to find solid ground before I hang myself on this flimsy neon wire.
Found a solid branch right here, no more flimsy neon wires. The espresso is getting cold but my ego is still steaming hot.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
